A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Self-Aligned Reward work and include readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F. Relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original math and logic benchmark evaluations, reward ablations, reasoning-behavior analyses, training measurements, and supplementary experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, ablations, training measurements, and empirical analyses in the appendices.

M1.justification: The SAR formula, its combination with verifiable rewards, and integration into PPO and Dr. GRPO remain unchanged. Appendix B retains the same functional pseudocode; baseline formulas move there from the main text.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same five math benchmarks and two logic benchmarks. Appendix E.2 retains evaluations of the same vision-language backbones on the existing text-based math tasks.

E2.justification: v2 removes the SFT comparator from all four panels of Figure 1. The PPO, GRPO, GRPO-O1, GRPO-ER, and entropy-reward comparisons in the corresponding experiments remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset splits and sample counts in Table 8, evaluation metrics including AES, training configurations in Table 9, and decoding settings are unchanged. The revised response-length entries do not establish a change in experimental procedure.

E4.justification: The reward-component ablations, alpha sweeps, reasoning-behavior analysis, training trajectories, KL-removal tests, and Appendix F cases are retained. No analysis is substantively added or removed.

E5.justification: There are no changes to seed or repeated-run information, confidence intervals, significance testing, or uncertainty-estimation procedures. Figure 4 retains the same training trajectories and shading.

E6.justification: The two no-thought response lengths change from 50.0 to 5.0 in Table 2 and from 50 to 5 in Table 12, while their advantages remain unchanged. Figure 1 also loses the SFT result points. The principal benchmark and supplementary result tables otherwise retain their values.

T1.justification: v2 explicitly states that SAR is strictly below 1 for positive perplexities. It removes v1's mathematical claim that SAR reaches a maximum of 1 only when standalone perplexity tends to infinity and conditioned perplexity equals 1. The objectives and Appendix D derivations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The central contribution and claims of improved accuracy, reduced response length, favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, and preserved reasoning behaviors remain. The revised abstract and conclusion foreground out-of-domain generalization already claimed and evaluated in v1.

C2.justification: v2 removes the hypothesis explaining SAR-only collapse through reward hacking and the stated motivation for Dr. GRPO involving unexpected length reduction under standard GRPO. The need for verifiable rewards and the vision-language limitations in Appendix E.2 remain.

D1.justification: v2 newly states that project code and data are publicly available and supplies a repository link; this availability is reported by the PDF, not independently verified. It also identifies the five math benchmarks as the source of the 200-question analysis. Hardware, hyperparameters, prompts, and functional pseudocode remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works are unchanged, as is the positioning against length-based and confidence-based rewards. Related work is condensed and relocated, without a substantive change in the claimed relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: The main text is extensively rewritten across the abstract, introduction, method explanations, results discussion, and conclusion. Related work moves from Section 6 to Section 2, and the baseline-formulation subsection moves into Appendix B.2. An LLM usage statement is also added.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn with SFT points removed and axes adjusted. Figure 3 is reformatted, Table 12 gives numerical columns more space, and several captions and float positions change. Conference headers are added; all four numbered figures and twelve tables remain.

improvement.justification: v2 adds concrete code/data access information, repairs the no-thought length entries, clarifies SAR's upper bound, and improves organization. These provide modest reproducibility and reporting gains despite the loss of the SFT comparison. The underlying empirical support and most appendix content remain unchanged.
